resources.string: Add a music folder or open a local audio file.
This device controls media volume externally.

A local music player for Android. Browse your collection, build playlists and personalize the listening screen.

MUSIC PLAYBACK
Play, pause, skip tracks, seek, rewind or fast-forward 10 seconds, and adjust media volume. Choose sequential or shuffle playback and repeat a song, a folder or selected folders. Playback continues in the background or with the screen off, with notification and standard Android/Bluetooth media controls. Launch restores the last queue and position without starting playback. Tap the top-left logo to return to Now playing.

FOLDERS AND USB
Add internal-storage or USB music folders, browse subfolders, play a folder, or open a single file. Device music and Browse device / USB music provide access to music indexed by Android. USB visibility depends on the device and its file manager. Reconnect unavailable storage or select the folder again to renew access.

LIBRARY AND PLAYLISTS
Use Browse to switch between Songs, Artists and Albums. Tap an artist or album to see its songs; albums are grouped by artist and album name. Search, sort, view tags and file locations, mark favorites, and select multiple songs for a playlist. Add, reorder or remove queue entries. Create playlists from songs, the queue or saved folders; edit, rename and refresh them. Quick rescan finds changes, while Full rescan refreshes all file tags. Pin folders to protect their library and playlist entries. Remove all folders, on the Folders page or in Folder settings, removes unpinned folder references together. Pinned folders and separately opened songs remain. Removing entries never deletes the music files.

SAVED POSITIONS
Each folder and playlist can remember its last song and time. Choose Restore position in the folder or playlist to load that position paused, then press Play when ready.

LOCAL BACKUPS
In General, save settings, background images, library references, favorites, playlists and collection positions as a ZIP backup. Restore merges music references and playlists while replacing settings and backgrounds. Audio and lyric files are not copied. On another device, copy your music separately, restore the ZIP, then add and scan the music folders and reconnect the restored entries. Locate music file reconnects an individual song.

LYRICS
Display embedded lyrics or matching LRC/TXT files beside the music. Customize placement, scrolling, font sizes and colors; enable drag-to-play to seek from the lyric guide. Optional online lookup finds lyrics when local lyrics are unavailable and can be switched off.

SPECTRUM
Choose line, Classic, Fire or theme-colored visualizations, with smooth bars or LED segments and custom colors. Tap the spectrum to cycle display styles. Select a 15, 30 or 60 Hz refresh rate. The spectrum visualizes audio; it does not change the sound.

APPEARANCE
Choose English or Simplified Chinese, day/night/system themes, custom accent colors, backgrounds and slideshows. Adjust blur, tint, block borders and brick shadows. Settings buttons follow the selected block style; turn off Block-style player controls to use standard controls. Place navigation at any edge; left/right buttons show labels below their icons. A compact playback row stays available while browsing or using Settings. Light mode uses a static background, fewer visual effects, and local or cached lyrics.

FORMAT SUPPORT
MP3, AAC/M4A, FLAC, PCM WAV, Ogg Vorbis and Opus are supported where the device provides compatible decoding. DRM-protected files, WMA and DSD are not guaranteed to play.

LYRIC VERSIONS, TIMING AND CACHE
The list button left of the source shows local and downloaded versions, highlighting the active one. Tap a version to use it now; separately mark its heart as Best for future plays. Best does not change the current display. Tap the filled heart to remove it. Long-press a row to activate it, change Best or delete its saved copy after confirmation. Deleting the active copy uses another saved or local version if available, without an online search or interrupting music. Original files are kept. This list uses existing files rather than online search candidates.

Search online lyrics opens a separate list immediately, then adds matches from every enabled provider as they respond. It shows up to ten matches per route, with title, artist, available duration and source. Only the version you tap is downloaded. The current lyrics remain until that download is saved successfully; selection does not change Best. Closing the window or changing songs cancels pending work. Online lyrics must be enabled and Light mode off.

The clock previews whole-song Earlier/Later corrections in 0.1-second and 1-second steps. Save keeps the correction with that version; Cancel discards the preview. Music and original lyric files are never changed.

Check cached song count/size, clear cached lyrics, or move the internal cache to a writable folder such as USB storage. Copies are verified before internal originals are removed. Each song retains versions within a 512 KiB limit. Set expiry independently for internal and portable caches: Never, 1, 7, 30 or 90 days. Defaults are 30 days internally and Never on USB. Each version keeps its original age; expired versions are removed on access or inspection without background polling. Internal storage also has a 100-song / 4 MiB limit, and Android may reclaim it. Clear, expiry or eviction removes the associated Best marks and timing corrections. Return to internal caching without deleting the USB collection. USB caching needs a compatible Android folder picker and persistent write access.

SYSTEM MUSIC PLAYER
General > Default music player opens Android app settings. Select ManaMusicPlayer if a music-app choice is offered. Otherwise, open a local audio document from a file manager, choose ManaMusicPlayer and select Always when available. Some car launchers have their own player setting. Opening a selected audio document starts playback; launching the music app normally does not.

SYSTEM PLAYBACK PANEL
Start a song and pull down the Android status bar for Previous, Play/Pause and Next. Expand the panel for Back 10 seconds and Forward 10 seconds. Tap the song card to return to Now playing. Controls continue to work while the player is in the background. Panel layout depends on Android and the device. If the panel is hidden, check the app notification settings and the Music playback channel.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Long-press an empty area of the home screen, open Widgets and choose ManaMusicPlayer. General also provides a Home screen widgets button for supported launchers. Controls (3x1) includes previous, play/pause, next, player mute and bottom progress. Artwork (3x1) adds a thumbnail behind Play; Lyrics (3x2) has top-aligned controls and current/next lyrics filling the space below; Play/Pause (1x1) is a single button. The lyric widget uses the current-line and other-line font sizes and colors from Lyrics settings. Larger fonts may need a taller widget. General > Widget background transparency adjusts the background without fading the controls. The lyric widget uses local or already cached lyrics and follows lyrics loaded in the player. Tap the background, lyric or progress bar to open Now playing for seeking; the artwork Play tile toggles playback. Mute affects only this player, not navigation or other apps. Progress updates pause when playback stops or the screen turns off. Adding a widget does not start playback. Grid sizes and resizing depend on the launcher; older placements may need resizing or re-adding.

APPEARANCE AND BUTTONS
Choose Customize under Appearance in General to show picture, slideshow, blur and tint controls there. Other themes hide those controls without deleting saved choices. Main-window button contents are centered. Selected navigation items, Favorite, Shuffle, Repeat and mute use 150% text/icon size while the buttons keep their dimensions. Settings detail controls retain their usual alignment.
